en.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Deflates to backpack size. Fits in any car. Ideal for travelers and apartment dwellers.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Drop-stitch PVC construction resists dings, scratches, and impacts. Won't snap or crack.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Fits in closet, under bed, or checked luggage. No roof rack needed.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Rigid, bulky. Requires roof rack or large vehicle. Difficult to transport alone.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Prone to dings, cracks, and pressure dents. Requires careful handling and storage.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Needs garage or wall space. Susceptible to heat damage in storage.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
en.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

en.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon was founded on a simple yet profound principle: to produce perfect products. This is not a marketing slogan — it is the bedrock of our operational philosophy, driving every material selection, design decision, and quality control protocol.
en.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: We invest considerable resources in identifying, testing, and procuring the finest fabrics, adhesives, and components available globally. We do not compromise on material specifications for cost savings. Our sourcing protocol includes batch testing for tensile strength, tear resistance, coating adhesion, and UV stability.
en.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon employs highly skilled technicians who are masters of their craft. Our production facility is equipped with state-of-the-art CNC cutting machines and thermo-welding equipment. We foster a culture of meticulousness, where attention to detail is paramount at every stage of assembly.
en.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Quality is built in from the very beginning. We implement a multi-layered QC system with stringent checks at each critical step, culminating in comprehensive final testing including 24–48 hour pressure holding tests, leak detection, dimensional verification, and functional tests.
en.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Exceptional stability and shallow draft. Features include rod holders, gear mounts, elevated seating, and quieter muted colors for stealth approach.
en.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Lightweight and compact for easy storage and lifting. Efficient rowing and motoring performance with reinforced towing points and substantial rub strakes.

en.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 main air chamber (+ a small outer safety rail on some models).
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 independent chambers. Each with its own valve and pressure integrity.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: None. Total loss of buoyancy on failure.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lighter. Fewer internal weld lines and valves mean less material.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Slightly heavier. Internal baffles and additional valve hardware add weight.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: More compact when deflated. Easier to store and travel with.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Slightly bulkier. Internal dividers prevent fully flat folding.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Faster. Only one chamber to inflate.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Slower. Each chamber must be inflated separately.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Good. Single large chamber holds uniform pressure.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Excellent. Internal baffles reduce flex and create a stiffer platform.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lower. Simpler manufacturing with fewer components.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Higher. Complex internal construction and additional valves increase cost.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderate. Single point of failure if the main chamber is compromised.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
en.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
en.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

de.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Wir investieren erhebliche Ressourcen in die Identifizierung, Prüfung und Beschaffung der besten weltweit verfügbaren Stoffe, Klebstoffe und Komponenten. Wir machen keine Kompromisse bei Materialspezifikationen zur Kosteneinsparung. Unser Beschaffungsprotokoll umfasst Chargenprüfungen auf Zugfestigkeit, Reißfestigkeit, Beschichtungshaftung und UV-Stabilität.
de.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Unser Designteam besteht aus erfahrenen Navalarchitekten, die fortschrittliche CAD-Software und praxisnahe Tests nutzen, um Rümpfe zu entwickeln, die hydrodynamisch effizient, außergewöhnlich stabil und robust sind. Jede Kurve, Naht und Befestigungspunkt wird sorgfältig geplant und analysiert.
de.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon beschäftigt hochqualifizierte Techniker, die Meister ihres Fachs sind. Unsere Produktionsstätte ist mit modernsten CNC-Schneidemaschinen und Thermoschweißgeräten ausgestattet. Wir fördern eine Kultur der Genauigkeit, bei der Liebe zum Detail in jeder Phase der Montage von größter Bedeutung ist.
de.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Qualität wird von Anfang an eingebaut. Wir implementieren ein mehrschichtiges QS-System mit strengen Kontrollen an jedem kritischen Schritt, gipfelnd in umfassenden Endprüfungen einschließlich 24–48-stündiger Druckhalteprüfungen, Lecksuche, Maßkontrolle und Funktionstests.
de.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Mehrschichtiges QS-System mit strengen Kontrollen in jedem kritischen Fertigungsschritt.
de.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Unsere Forschungseinrichtungen inklusive PVC-Stofflabor, hydrodynamischem Testbecken und Prototypenwerkstatt.
de.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: 12.000 m² Anlage mit HF-Schweißen, Drop-Stitch-Produktion und kundenspezifischen Montagelinien.
de.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Full-Service-Designstudio für kundenspezifische ODM-Projekte, vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.
de.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Außergewöhnliche Stabilität und geringer Tiefgang. Merkmale umfassen Rutenhalter, Halterungen für Ausrüstung, erhöhte Sitze und gedämpftere Farben für lautlose Annäherung.
de.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Leicht und kompakt für einfache Lagerung und Hebevorgänge. Effiziente Ruder- und Motorfahrleistung mit verstärkten Schlepppunkten und robusten Scheuerleisten.
de.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon wurde auf einem einfachen, aber tiefgründigen Prinzip gegründet: perfekte Produkte herzustellen. Dies ist kein Marketing-Slogan — es ist das Fundament unserer Betriebsphilosophie, die jede Materialauswahl, Designentscheidung und Qualitätskontrollprotokoll antreibt.
de.faq.inflatable.maintenance.a: Grundlegende Wartung: nach jedem Gebrauch mit Süßwasser abspülen, vor der Lagerung gründlich trocknen, auf Lecks an Nähten und Ventilen prüfen, Ventile jährlich mit Silikonfett schmieren.

de.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
de.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Einfach. Nur eine Kammer muss lokalisiert und geflickt werden.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Mäßig. Die undichte Kammer muss zunächst identifiziert werden. Der Reparaturvorgang ist derselbe.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 Haupt-Luftkammer (+ eine kleine äußere Sicherheitsleiste bei einigen Modellen).
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 unabhängige Kammern. Jede mit eigenem Ventil und eigener Druckintegrität.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Keine. Totaler Auftriebsverlust bei einem Defekt.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Leichter. Weniger innere Schweißnähte und Ventile bedeuten weniger Material.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Etwas schwerer. Innere Trennwände und zusätzliche Ventile bringen mehr Gewicht mit sich.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Kompakter im entleerten Zustand. Leichter zu verstauen und zu transportieren.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Etwas sperriger. Innere Trennwände verhindern das völlig flache Zusammenfalten.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Schneller. Nur eine Kammer muss aufgepumpt werden.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Langsamer. Jede Kammer muss einzeln aufgepumpt werden.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Gut. Eine einzelne große Kammer hält den Druck gleichmäßig.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Hervorragend. Innere Trennwände reduzieren die Flexion und schaffen eine steifere Plattform.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Niedriger. Einfachere Fertigung mit weniger Komponenten.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Höher. Die komplexe Innenkonstruktion und zusätzlichen Ventile erhöhen die Kosten.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Mäßig. Einzelner Schwachpunkt, wenn die Hauptkammer beschädigt wird.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
de.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
de.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

pt.engineeringPerfection.heading: Excelência em Engenharia
pt.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: A olagoon foi fundada com um princípio simples, porém profundo: produzir produtos perfeitos. Isso não é um slogan de marketing — é a base da nossa filosofia operacional, orientando cada seleção de material, decisão de design e protocolo de controle de qualidade.
pt.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Investimos recursos consideráveis na identificação, teste e aquisição dos melhores tecidos, adesivos e componentes disponíveis globalmente. Não comprometemos as especificações dos materiais para reduzir custos. Nosso protocolo de fornecimento inclui testes em lote de resistência à tração, resistência ao rasgo, adesão de revestimento e estabilidade UV.
pt.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Nossa equipe de design é composta por arquitetos navais experientes que utilizam software CAD avançado e testes no mundo real para criar cascos hidrodinamicamente eficientes, excepcionalmente estáveis e robustos. Cada curva, costura e ponto de fixação é meticulosamente planejado e analisado.
pt.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: A olagoon emprega técnicos altamente qualificados que são mestres em seu ofício. Nossa instalação de produção é equipada com máquinas de corte CNC de última geração e equipamentos de termossoldagem. Promovemos uma cultura de meticulosidade, onde a atenção aos detalhes é primordial em cada etapa da montagem.
pt.engineeringPerfection.p4: Controle de Qualidade e Testes Rigorosos
pt.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: A qualidade é incorporada desde o início. Implementamos um sistema de CQ multicamadas com verificações rigorosas em cada etapa crítica, culminando em testes finais abrangentes, incluindo testes de retenção de pressão de 24 a 48 horas, detecção de vazamentos, verificação dimensional e testes funcionais.
pt.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Estabilidade excepcional e calado raso. Recursos incluem suportes de vara, montagens de equipamento, assentos elevados e cores suaves e silenciosas para aproximação discreta.
pt.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Leves e compactos para fácil armazenamento e içamento. Desempenho eficiente a remo e motor com pontos de reboque reforçados e defensas substanciais.
pt.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Design versátil para passeios em família com alta prioridade em estabilidade, segurança, conforto e facilidade de inflar, esvaziar e transportar.

pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Desinfla para tamanho de mochila. Cabe em qualquer carro. Ideal para viajantes e moradores de apartamento.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Construção em PVC drop-stitch resiste a amassados, arranhões e impactos. Não quebra ou racha.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Cabe em armário, debaixo da cama ou bagagem despachada. Não precisa de suporte de teto.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Rígido, volumoso. Requer suporte de teto ou veículo grande. Difícil de transportar sozinho.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Propenso a amassados, rachaduras e marcas de pressão. Requer manuseio e armazenamento cuidadosos.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Precisa de garagem ou espaço na parede. Suscetível a danos por calor no armazenamento.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
pt.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.

pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simples. Uma única câmara para localizar e remendar.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderado. É necessário identificar qual câmara está vazando. O processo de reparo é o mesmo.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 câmara de ar principal (+ um pequeno trilho de segurança externo em alguns modelos).
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 câmaras independentes. Cada uma com sua própria válvula e integridade de pressão.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Nenhuma. Perda total de flutuação em caso de falha.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Mais leve. Menos linhas de solda internas e válvulas significam menos material.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Um pouco mais pesado. Defletores internos e hardware de válvula adicional adicionam peso.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mais compacto quando esvaziada. Mais fácil de armazenar e transportar.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Um pouco mais volumosa. Divisórias internas impedem dobragem totalmente plana.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Mais rápido. Apenas uma câmara para inflar.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Mais lento. Cada câmara deve ser inflada separadamente.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Boa. Uma única câmara grande mantém pressão uniforme.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Excelente. Defletores internos reduzem a flexão e criam uma plataforma mais rígida.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Menor. Fabricação mais simples com menos componentes.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Maior. Construção interna complexa e válvulas adicionais aumentam o custo.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderada. Ponto único de falha se a câmara principal for comprometida.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.
pt.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersTitle: Por Que o Número de Câmaras Importa

fr.home.problem.subtitle: La plupart des équipements sont conçus soit pour la performance extrême, soit pour la récréation économique. Peu existe pour le juste milieu — des expériences aquatiques contrôlées, sécurisées et formatrices où l'équipement correspond à la fois à l'environnement et aux capacités de l'utilisateur.

fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Se dégonfle en format sac à dos. Tient dans n'importe quelle voiture. Idéal pour les voyageurs.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: La construction PVC drop-stitch résiste aux chocs, rayures et impacts. Ne se fissure pas.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Se range dans un placard, sous le lit ou en bagage en soute. Pas de galerie de toit nécessaire.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Rigide, encombrant. Nécessite une galerie de toit ou un grand véhicule. Difficile à transporter seul.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Sujet aux bosses, fissures et impacts. Nécessite une manipulation soigneuse et un stockage adapté.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Nécessite un garage ou un mur de rangement. Sensible à la chaleur au stockage.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
fr.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

fr.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simple. Une seule chambre à localiser et à réparer.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Modérée. Il faut identifier la chambre qui fuit. Le processus de réparation est identique.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 chambre à air principale (+ un petit rail de sécurité extérieur sur certains modèles).
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3 à 5 chambres indépendantes. Chacune avec sa propre valve et son intégrité de pression.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Aucune. Perte totale de flottabilité en cas de défaillance.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Plus léger. Moins de lignes de soudure internes et de valves, donc moins de matériau.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Légèrement plus lourd. Les cloisons internes et les valves supplémentaires ajoutent du poids.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Plus compact dégonflée. Plus facile à ranger et à transporter.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Légèrement plus volumineuse. Les cloisons internes empêchent un pliage parfaitement plat.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Plus rapide. Une seule chambre à gonfler.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Plus lent. Chaque chambre doit être gonflée séparément.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Bonne. Une grande chambre unique maintient une pression uniforme.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Excellente. Les cloisons internes réduisent la flexion et créent une plateforme plus rigide.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Plus bas. Fabrication plus simple avec moins de composants.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Plus élevé. La construction interne complexe et les valves supplémentaires augmentent le coût.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Modérée. Point de défaillance unique si la chambre principale est compromise.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.
fr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersTitle: Pourquoi le nombre de chambres compte

es.compare.pvcVsHypalon.repairDesc: Excelente. Los parches de PVC se adhieren fácilmente con pegamento estándar para PVC o soldadura con solvente.
es.compare.pvcVsHypalon.weldDesc: La soldadura de alta frecuencia (RF) crea costuras fuertes y consistentes. Unión por fusión disponible.
es.compare.pvcVsHypalon.hypalonWeightDesc: Más pesado que PVC. Aprox. 15-20% más de peso de tela. Más robusto al tacto.
es.compare.pvcVsHypalon.hypalonRepairDesc: Más desafiante. Requiere adhesivo de dos componentes y preparación cuidadosa de la superficie. La reparación en campo es menos práctica.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Se desinfla al tamaño de una mochila. cabe en cualquier auto. Ideal para viajeros y habitantes de apartamentos.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: La construcción de PVC drop-stitch resiste abolladuras, rayones e impactos. No se rompe ni se agrieta.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Cabe en armario, debajo de la cama o en equipaje facturado. No se necesita portaequipajes.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Rígida y voluminosa. Requiere portaequipajes o vehículo grande. Difícil de transportar sola.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Propensa a abolladuras, grietas y marcas de presión. Requiere manejo y almacenamiento cuidadosos.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Necesita garaje o espacio en pared. Susceptible a daños por calor en almacenamiento.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
es.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

es.commercialWorkboats.f2desc: Thermo-welding creates molecular bonds stronger than the fabric itself. For applications requiring adhesives, we use high-performance two-part polyurethane adhesives in climate-controlled environments. Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.
es.commercialWorkboats.f3desc: Hardware de acero inoxidable 316 de grado marino, rebordes de protección de servicio pesado, transomes reforzados con grandes traslapos de tela y múltiples cámaras de aire independientes (3-5+) con tabiques internos para redundancia ante daños. Cada punto de anclaje usa parches de refuerzo sustanciales.
es.commercialWorkboats.a1desc: Plataformas estables para despliegue y recuperación de buzos con amplio espacio en cubierta para tanques y equipo.
es.commercialWorkboats.a2desc: Capacidad de respuesta rápida con excelente maniobrabilidad en puertos confinados y aguas costeras.
es.commercialWorkboats.a3desc: Materiales resistentes a químicos para exposición a combustible, aceite y solventes. Construcción robusta para operaciones sostenidas.
es.commercialWorkboats.a4desc: Plataformas silenciosas y estables para levantamiento hidrográfico, monitoreo ambiental e investigación científica.
es.commercialWorkboats.a6desc: Plataformas de despliegue rápido para apoyo en lucha contra incendios y respuesta a emergencias en aguas poco profundas.

es.engineeringPerfection.heading: Perfección en Ingeniería
es.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon fue fundado sobre un principio simple pero profundo: producir productos perfectos. Esto no es un eslogan de marketing, es la base de nuestra filosofía operativa, impulsando cada selección de material, decisión de diseño y protocolo de control de calidad.
es.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Invertimos recursos considerables en identificar, probar y adquirir las mejores telas, adhesivos y componentes disponibles globalmente. No comprometemos las especificaciones de materiales para ahorrar costos. Nuestro protocolo de abastecimiento incluye pruebas por lotes de resistencia a la tracción, resistencia al desgarro, adhesión del recubrimiento y estabilidad UV.
es.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Nuestro equipo de diseño cuenta con arquitectos navales experimentados que aprovechan software CAD avanzado y pruebas del mundo real para crear cascos hidrodinámicamente eficientes, excepcionalmente estables y robustos. Cada curva, costura y punto de unión se planifica y analiza meticulosamente.
es.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon emplea técnicos altamente calificados que son maestros en su oficio. Nuestra instalación de producción está equipada con máquinas de corte CNC de última generación y equipos de termosoldadura. Fomentamos una cultura de meticulosidad, donde la atención al detalle es primordial en cada etapa del ensamblaje.
es.engineeringPerfection.p4: Control de Calidad y Pruebas Rigurosas
es.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: La calidad se construye desde el principio. Implementamos un sistema de control de calidad multicapa con verificaciones estrictas en cada paso crítico, que culmina en pruebas finales integrales que incluyen pruebas de retención de presión de 24–48 horas, detección de fugas, verificación dimensional y pruebas funcionales.
es.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Estabilidad excepcional y calado poco profundo. Incluye portacañas, soportes para equipo, asientos elevados y colores apagados más silenciosos para un enfoque sigiloso.
es.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Ligeros y compactos para fácil almacenamiento y elevación. Rendimiento eficiente de remo y motorización con puntos de remolque reforzados y defensas sustanciales.
es.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Diseño versátil para navegación familiar con alta prioridad en estabilidad, seguridad, comodidad y facilidad de inflado, desinflado y transporte.

es.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
es.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simple. Una sola cámara para localizar y parchar.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderada. Hay que identificar qué cámara pierde aire. El proceso de reparación es el mismo.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 cámara de aire principal (+ un pequeño riel exterior de seguridad en algunos modelos).
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 cámaras independientes. Cada una con su propia válvula e integridad de presión.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Ninguna. Pérdida total de flotabilidad ante una falla.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Más ligera. Menos líneas de soldadura internas y válvulas significan menos material.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Ligeramente más pesada. Los deflectores internos y el hardware de válvulas adicional añaden peso.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Más compacta al desinflarse. Más fácil de guardar y transportar.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Ligeramente más voluminosa. Los divisores internos impiden un plegado completamente plano.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Más rápido. Solo una cámara para inflar.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Más lento. Cada cámara debe inflarse por separado.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Buena. Una sola cámara grande mantiene presión uniforme.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Excelente. Los deflectores internos reducen la flexión y crean una plataforma más rígida.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Menor. Fabricación más simple con menos componentes.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Mayor. La construcción interna compleja y las válvulas adicionales aumentan el costo.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderada. Punto único de falla si la cámara principal se compromete.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
es.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
es.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

it.faq.inflatable.maintenance: Che manutenzione necessitano le barche gonfiabili?
it.faq.inflatable.maintenance.a: Manutenzione di base: risciacquare con acqua dolce dopo ogni utilizzo, asciugare completamente prima dello stoccaggio, controllare le perdite alle giunzioni e valvole, lubrificare le valvole annualmente con grasso al silicone.
it.faq.inflatable.repair: Le barche gonfiabili possono essere riparate?
it.faq.inflatable.storage.a: Sì, ma con precauzioni. Gonfia alla pressione nominale e controlla settimanalmente poiché i cambiamenti di temperatura influenzano la pressione. Usa una copertura se conservata all'aperto.

it.commercialWorkboats.ctaSub: Materiali premium, tecnologia avanzata delle giunzioni e costruzione robusta si traducono in meno riparazioni, meno tempi morti e una vita operativa più lunga. Le barche olagoon offrono un valore eccezionale durante l'intera vita utile, non solo al momento dell'acquisto.

it.commercialWorkboats.f2desc: Thermo-welding creates molecular bonds stronger than the fabric itself. For applications requiring adhesives, we use high-performance two-part polyurethane adhesives in climate-controlled environments. Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.

it.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon impiega tecnici altamente qualificati, maestri nel loro mestiere. La nostra struttura produttiva è dotata di macchine da taglio CNC all'avanguardia e saldatrici termiche.

it.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
it.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Semplice. Una sola camera da individuare e riparare.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderata. Occorre individuare quale camera perde aria. Il processo di riparazione è identico.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 camera d'aria principale (+ un piccolo bordo di sicurezza esterno su alcuni modelli).
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 camere indipendenti. Ognuna con la propria valvola e tenuta di pressione.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Nessuna. Perdita totale di galleggiabilità in caso di guasto.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Più leggera. Meno linee di saldatura interne e meno valvole significano meno materiale.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Leggermente più pesante. Diaframmi interni e valvole aggiuntive aumentano il peso.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Più compatta da sgonfia. Più facile da riporre e portare in viaggio.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Leggermente più ingombrante. I divisori interni impediscono una piegatura completamente piatta.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Più veloce. Una sola camera da gonfiare.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Più lento. Ogni camera va gonfiata separatamente.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Buona. Un'unica grande camera mantiene una pressione uniforme.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Eccellente. I diaframmi interni riducono la flessione e creano una piattaforma più rigida.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Più basso. Produzione più semplice con meno componenti.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Più alto. Costruzione interna complessa e valvole aggiuntive aumentano i costi.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderata. Singolo punto di guasto se la camera principale viene compromessa.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
it.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.
it.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersTitle: Perché il Numero di Camere È Importante

ru.faq.inflatable.maintenance.a: Основной уход: ополаскивайте пресной водой после каждого использования, тщательно просушивайте перед хранением, проверяйте швы и клапаны на утечки, смазывайте клапаны силиконовой смазкой раз в год.
ru.faq.inflatable.repair.a: Да. Небольшие проколы и утечки по швам можно устранить ремкомплектом для ПВХ. Крупные повреждения могут потребовать профессионального ремонта. Хайпалон требует двухкомпонентного клея и более тщательной подготовки.
ru.faq.inflatable.storage.a: Да, но с осторожностью. Накачайте до указанного давления и проверяйте еженедельно, так как перепады температуры влияют на давление. Используйте чехол при хранении на улице.

ru.commercialWorkboats.a2desc: Способность к быстрому реагированию с отличной маневренностью в ограниченных гаванях и прибрежных водах.
ru.commercialWorkboats.a3desc: Химически стойкие материалы для воздействия топлива, масел и растворителей. Прочная конструкция для длительной эксплуатации.
ru.commercialWorkboats.a4desc: Тихие стабильные платформы для гидрографических изысканий, мониторинга окружающей среды и научных исследований.

Спроектирован для превосходной износостойкости, УФ-стабилизации, химической стойкости и устойчивости к экстремальным температурам.
ru.commercialWorkboats.f2desc: Thermo-welding creates molecular bonds stronger than the fabric itself. For applications requiring adhesives, we use high-performance two-part polyurethane adhesives in climate-controlled environments. Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.
ru.commercialWorkboats.f3desc: Фурнитура из морской нержавеющей стали 316, усиленные привальные брусья, усиленные транцы с большими тканевыми нахлестами и 3-5+ независимых воздушных отсеков с внутренними переборками.

ru.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Мы инвестируем значительные ресурсы в поиск, тестирование и закупку лучших тканей, клеев и компонентов. Протокол включает проверку партий на прочность, стойкость к разрыву и УФ-стабильность.
ru.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Наша команда опытных морских архитекторов использует CAD и реальные испытания для создания гидродинамически эффективных и устойчивых корпусов.
ru.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon нанимает высококвалифицированных техников. Производство оснащено станками ЧПУ и термосварочным оборудованием. Внимание к деталям на каждом этапе сборки.
ru.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Многоуровневая система ОТК с проверками на каждом этапе, включая 24–48 часовые тесты давлением, проверку на утечки и контроль размеров.
ru.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Многоуровневая система ОТК со строгими проверками на каждом этапе производства.
ru.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Исследовательские лаборатории: лаборатория ПВХ, гидродинамический бассейн и цех прототипов.
ru.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: Предприятие 12 000 м² с ВЧ-сваркой, производством drop-stitch и сборочными линиями.
ru.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Студия дизайна для проектов ODM от концепции до производства.
ru.engineeringPerfection.s1desc: Высокопрочный ПВХ или Хайпалон с усилением, самосливные полы, большие диаметры баллонов и леера.

ru.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Просто. Единственная камера — легко найти и заклеить.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Средняя сложность. Нужно определить, какая камера пропускает воздух. Сам процесс ремонта такой же.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 основная воздушная камера (+ небольшой внешний защитный борт на некоторых моделях).
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 независимых камер. Каждая — со своим клапаном и собственной герметичностью.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Нет. При повреждении — полная потеря плавучести.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Легче. Меньше внутренних сварных швов и клапанов — меньше материала.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Немного тяжелее. Внутренние перегородки и дополнительная клапанная фурнитура добавляют вес.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Компактнее в спущенном виде. Удобнее хранить и перевозить.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Немного громоздче. Внутренние перегородки не позволяют сложить борд идеально плоско.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Быстрее. Накачать нужно только одну камеру.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Медленнее. Каждую камеру нужно накачивать отдельно.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Хорошая. Одна большая камера держит равномерное давление.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Отличная. Внутренние перегородки снижают прогиб и делают платформу жёстче.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Ниже. Более простое производство и меньше компонентов.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Выше. Сложная внутренняя конструкция и дополнительные клапаны увеличивают цену.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Средняя. Единственная точка отказа при повреждении основной камеры.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
ru.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

pl.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Prosta. Jedna komora do zlokalizowania i załatania.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Umiarkowana. Trzeba ustalić, która komora traci powietrze. Sama procedura naprawy jest taka sama.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 główna komora powietrzna (+ mała zewnętrzna listwa bezpieczeństwa w niektórych modelach).
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 niezależnych komór, każda z własnym zaworem i szczelnością ciśnieniową.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Brak. Całkowita utrata wyporności w razie awarii.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Mniejsza. Mniej wewnętrznych linii spawania i zaworów oznacza mniej materiału.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Nieco większa. Wewnętrzne przegrody i dodatkowe zawory dodają ciężaru.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Bardziej kompaktowa po spuszczeniu powietrza. Łatwiejsza w przechowywaniu i transporcie.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Nieco bardziej objętościowa. Wewnętrzne przegrody uniemożliwiają całkowicie płaskie złożenie.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Krótszy. Do napompowania tylko jedna komora.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Dłuższy. Każdą komorę trzeba napompować osobno.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Dobra. Jedna duża komora utrzymuje równomierne ciśnienie.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Doskonała. Wewnętrzne przegrody ograniczają uginanie i tworzą sztywniejszą platformę.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Niższy. Prostsza produkcja przy mniejszej liczbie komponentów.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Wyższy. Skomplikowana konstrukcja wewnętrzna i dodatkowe zawory podnoszą koszt.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Umiarkowana. Pojedynczy punkt awarii w razie uszkodzenia głównej komory.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
pl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

ar.home.why.quality.point1: لا يُكسر — مصنوع من PVC عالي الكثافة ليتحمل أقسى الظروف.
ar.home.why.quality.point2: مهندس بدقة — درزات مثالية وسلامة هوائية لتجارب خالية من القلق.
ar.home.why.quality.point3: مختبر بلا توقف — أثبت أنه يتفوق ويصمد ويتألق.
ar.home.why.availability.point1: جاهز عندما ترغب — بدون انتظار. مخزون مرئي: تحديثات فورية لتعرف ما هو جاهز للشحن.
ar.home.why.availability.point2: شحن سريع: الطلبات المخزونة تُشحن في 2-3 أيام؛ الاحتياجات العاجلة تحصل على معاملة مميزة.
ar.home.why.availability.point3: بدوا مفاجآت: جداول زمنية واضحة، تنبيهات تأخير، وحلول فورية إذا تغيرت الخطط.
ar.home.why.price.point1: تفصيل تكلفة شفاف: اعرف بالضبط ما تدفعه مقابل أعلى معايير المتانة والأداء.
ar.home.why.price.point2: ضمان مطابقة السعر: سنُطابق السعر ونضيف امتداد ضمان مجاني لمدة سنة.
ar.home.why.price.point3: مبني ليصمد، مصمم لتوفير: لا هجر مُخطط — منتجات تصمد لسنوات من الاستخدام.
ar.home.why.warranty.point2: امتثال معتمد: جميع المنتجات تلبي أو تتجاوز معايير السلامة CE وISO وحرس الساحل الأمريكي.
ar.home.why.warranty.point3: إصلاحات خالية من التوتر: قدّم مطالبة في دقائق، واحصل على إصلاح أو بديل في أيام.

ar.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: بسيط. حجرة واحدة يمكن تحديد موقعها وترقيعها.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: متوسط. يجب تحديد أي حجرة هي المسرّبة. وإجراءات الإصلاح واحدة في الحالتين.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: حجرة هواء رئيسية واحدة (+ حافة أمان خارجية صغيرة في بعض الطُرز).
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 حجرات مستقلة، لكل منها صمامها الخاص وتكاملها في الضغط.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: لا شيء. فقدان كامل للطفوية عند الفشل.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: أخف وزنًا. خطوط لحام داخلية وصمامات أقل تعني مواد أقل.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: أثقل قليلاً. الحواجز الداخلية وعُدد الصمامات الإضافية تضيف وزنًا.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: أكثر إحكامًا عند تفريغ الهواء. أسهل في التخزين والتنقل.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: أكبر حجمًا قليلاً. الحواجز الداخلية تمنع الطي المسطح تمامًا.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: أبطأ. يجب نفخ كل حجرة على حدة.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: جيد. حجرة واحدة كبيرة تحافظ على ضغط موحّد.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: ممتاز. الحواجز الداخلية تقلل الانثناء وتخلق منصة أكثر صلابة.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: أعلى. البناء الداخلي المعقد والصمامات الإضافية يرفعان التكلفة.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: متوسطة. نقطة فشل واحدة إذا تعرضت الحجرة الرئيسية للتلف.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
ar.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.

nl.engineeringPerfection.artTitle: De kunst en wetenschap van productie
nl.engineeringPerfection.expSub: Echte voorbeelden van hoe onze technische normen zich vertalen in veldprestaties.
nl.engineeringPerfection.heading: Technische perfectie
nl.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: We investeren aanzienlijke middelen in het identificeren, testen en verkrijgen van de beste stoffen, lijmen en componenten wereldwijd. We doen geen concessies aan materiaalspecificaties voor kostenbesparing. Ons inkoopprotocol omvat batchgewijs testen op treksterkte, scheurweerstand, coatingadhesie en UV-stabiliteit.
nl.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Ons ontwerpteam bestaat uit ervaren maritieme architecten die geavanceerde CAD-software en real-world testen gebruiken om rompen te creëren die hydrodynamisch efficiënt, uitzonderlijk stabiel en robuust zijn. Elke curve, naad en bevestigingspunt wordt minutieus gepland en geanalyseerd.
nl.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon werkt met hooggekwalificeerde technici die meesters zijn in hun vak. Onze productiefaciliteit is uitgerust met state-of-the-art CNC-snijmachines en thermolasmachines. We bevorderen een cultuur van nauwgezetheid, waarbij aandacht voor detail voorop staat in elke fase van de assemblage.
nl.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kwaliteit wordt vanaf het begin ingebouwd. We implementeren een gelaagd QC-systeem met strikte controles bij elke kritieke stap, culminerend in uitgebreide eindtesten inclusief 24–48 uur durende druktesten, lektesten, maatvoeringscontrole en functionele testen.
nl.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Gelaagd QC-systeem met strikte controles bij elke kritieke productiestap.
nl.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Onze onderzoeksfaciliteiten inclusief PVC-stoffenlab, hydrodynamische testtank en prototypewerkplaats.
nl.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: 12.000 m² faciliteit met RF-lassen, drop-stitch productie en montagelijnen op maat.
nl.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Full-service ontwerpstudio voor ODM-projecten op maat, van concept tot productie.
nl.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Uitzonderlijke stabiliteit en ondiepe diepgang. Functies omvatten hengelhouders, uitrustingsbevestigingen, verhoogde zitplaatsen en stillere gedempte kleuren voor stealth-benadering.
nl.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Lichtgewicht en compact voor eenvoudige opslag en hijsen. Efficiënte roei- en motorbesturing met versterkte sleeppunten en stevige slijtlijsten.
nl.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Veelzijdig ontwerp voor gezinsvaart met hoge prioriteit voor stabiliteit, veiligheid, comfort en eenvoudig opblazen, leeglaten en vervoer.
nl.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon is opgericht met een eenvoudig maar diepgaand principe: perfecte producten produceren. Dit is geen marketingslogan — het is de basis van onze operationele filosofie, die elke materiaalkeuze, ontwerpbeslissing en kwaliteitscontroleprotocol aanstuurt.
nl.engineeringPerfection.title: Technische perfectie — uitmuntende productie van opblaasbare boten

nl.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Eenvoudig. Eén kamer om te lokaliseren en te plakken.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Gematigd. U moet vaststellen welke kamer lekt. Het reparatieproces is hetzelfde.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 hoofdluchtkamer (+ een kleine buitenste veiligheidsrail op sommige modellen).
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 onafhankelijke kamers, elk met een eigen ventiel en drukintegriteit.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Geen. Volledig verlies van drijfvermogen bij uitval.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lichter. Minder interne lasnaden en ventielen betekenen minder materiaal.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Iets zwaarder. Interne tussenschotten en extra ventielhardware voegen gewicht toe.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Compacter wanneer leeg. Eenvoudiger op te bergen en mee te nemen op reis.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Iets omvangrijker. Interne scheidingswanden voorkomen volledig platvouwen.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Sneller. Slechts één kamer om op te pompen.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Langzamer. Elke kamer moet apart worden opgepompt.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Goed. Eén grote kamer houdt de druk gelijkmatig vast.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Uitstekend. Interne tussenschotten verminderen doorbuiging en creëren een stijver platform.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lager. Eenvoudigere productie met minder onderdelen.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Hoger. Complexe interne constructie en extra ventielen verhogen de kosten.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Gematigd. Eén zwak punt als de hoofdkamer wordt aangetast.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
nl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

sv.engineeringPerfection.expSub: Praktiska exempel på hur våra tekniska standarder förvandlas till fält prestanda.
sv.engineeringPerfection.heading: Perfektion i tekniken
sv.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Vi investerar betydande resurser i identifiering, provning och inköp av de bästa tillgängliga tygen, limmen och komponenterna i världen. Vi gör inga kompromisser med materialspecifikationer för att sänka kostnader. Vårt inköpsprotokoll inkluderar parti tester för draghållfasthet, rivhållfasthet, beläggningsadhäsion och UV-stabilitet.
sv.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Vårt designteam består av erfarna skeppskonstruktörer som använder avancerad CAD-programvara och praktiskt test för att utveckla skrov som är hydrodynamiskt effektiva, exceptionellt stabila och robusta. Varje kurva, söm och fästpunkt noggrant planerad och analyserad.
sv.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon anlitar högt kvalificerade tekniker som är mästare i sitt fack. Vår tillverkningsanläggning är utrustad med toppmoderna CNC-skärningsmaskiner och termosvetsutrustning. Vi främjar en kultur av noggrannhet, där kärlek till detaljer i varje monteringsfas är av yttersta vikt.
sv.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kaliitet byggs in från starten. Vi implementerar ett flerskiktigt kvalitetssystem med stränga kontroller vid varje kritiskt steg, krönt av omfattande slutkontroller inklusive 24–48-timmars tryckhållningstester, läckagekontroll, målkontroll och funktionsprovning.
sv.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Flerstegs kvalitetssystem med stränga kontroller vid varje kritiskt tillverkningssteg.
sv.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Våra forskningsanläggningar inkluderar PVC-tyglab, hydrodynamisk testdäck och prototyptillverkning.
sv.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: 12 000 m² anläggning med HF-svetsning, drop-stitch-tillverkning och anpassade monteringslinjer.
sv.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Fullservice designstudio för anpassade ODM-projekt, från koncept till produktion.
sv.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Exceptionell stabilitet och lågt djupgående. Funktionerna inkluderar stanghållare, utrustningshållare, upphöjda säten och dämpade färger för tyst närmande.
sv.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Lätt och kompakt för enkel förvaring och lyft. Effektiv rod och motorprestanda med förstärkta bogar och robusta sliskar.
sv.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon grundades på ett enkelt men djuptgående princip: att skapa perfekta produkter. Detta är ingen marknadsföringsslogan — det är grunden för vår driftsfilosofi som driver varje materialval, designbeslut och kvalitetskontroll protokoll.
sv.solutionsByUseCase.answer7: Vi för ditt koncept till produktion: industridesign, formtillverkning, prototypering, provning och massproduktion. Vårt FoU-center stöder CAD/FEA-simulering, hydrodynamiska tester och materialval.

sv.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Enkelt. Endast en kammare att hitta och laga.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Måttligt. Man måste ta reda på vilken kammare som läcker. Reparationsprocessen är densamma.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 huvudluftkammare (+ en liten yttre säkerhetskammare på vissa modeller).
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 oberoende kammare. Var och en med egen ventil och tryckintegritet.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Ingen. Total förlust av flytkraft vid fel.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lättare. Färre inre svetsfogar och ventiler ger mindre materialåtgång.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Något tyngre. Inre skiljeväggar och extra ventildetaljer ökar vikten.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mer kompakt i nedblåst skick. Enklare att förvara och ta med på resa.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Något skrymmande. Inre avdelare hindrar helt platt vikning.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Snabbare. Endast en kammare att blåsa upp.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Långsammare. Varje kammare måste blåsas upp separat.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Bra. En enda stor kammare håller ett enhetligt tryck.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Utmärkt. Inre skiljeväggar minskar flexen och ger en styvare plattform.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lägre. Enklare tillverkning med färre komponenter.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Högre. Komplex inre konstruktion och fler ventiler höjer kostnaden.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Måttlig. En enskild felpunkt om huvudkammaren skadas.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
sv.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

no.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Tømmes til ryggsekkstørrelse. Passer i ethvert bil. Ideelt for reisende og leilighetsbeboere.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Drop-stitch PVC-konstruksjon motstår slag, riper og støt. Vil ikke sprekke eller knekke.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Passer i skap, under sengen, eller som innsjekket bagasje. Ingen takstativ behøves.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Stiv, bulkete. Krever takstativ eller stort kjøretøy. Vanskelig å transportere alene.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Utsatt for slag, sprekker og trykkskader. Krever forsiktig håndtering og lagring.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Trenger garasje eller veggplass. Utsatt for varmeskader i lagring.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
no.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

no.engineeringPerfection.heading: Ingeniørperfeksjon
no.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon ble grunnlagt på et enkelt men dyptgående prinsipp: å produsere perfekte produkter. Dette er ikke en markedsføringsslagord — det er grunnmuren i vår operasjonelle filosofi, som driver hvert materialvalg, designdecision og kvalitetskontroll-protokoll.
no.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Vi investerer betydelige ressurser i å identifisere, teste og anskaffe de fineste stoffene, limene og komponentene tilgjengelig globalt. Vi kompromitterer ikke på materialspesifikasjoner for å spare penger. Vår anskaffelsesprotokoll inkluderer batch-testing for strekkfasthet, rivestyrke, beleggsheftning og UV-stabilitet.
no.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Vårt designteam består av erfarne marinearkitekter som bruker avansert CAD-programvare og reell testing for å skape skrog som er hydrodynamisk effektive, eksepsjonelt stabile og robuste. Hver kurve, søm og festepunkt er nøye planlagt og analysert.
no.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon ansetter høyt kvalifiserte teknikere som er mestere i sitt fag. Vår produksjonsfasilitet er utstyrt med toppmoderne CNC-skjæremaskiner og termosveiseutstyr. Vi dyrker en kultur av nøyaktighet, der oppmerksomhet på detaljer er avgjørende på hvert trinn i monteringen.
no.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kvalitet er bygget inn fra begynnelsen. Vi implementerer et flerlags QC-system med strenge kontroller på hvert kritisk trinn, kronet med omfattende slutttester inkludert 24–48 timers trykkholdstester, lekkasjepåvisning, dimensjonsverifisering og funksjonstester.
no.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Eksepsjonell stabilitet og grunn dybde. Funksjoner inkluderer stangholdere, utstyrsfester, høyere seter, og dempede farger for diskret tilnærming.
no.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Lett og kompakt for enkel lagring og heising. Effektiv ro- og motor ytelse med forsterkede slepepunkter og solide gummilister.
no.engineeringPerfection.expSub: Ekte eksempler på hvordan våre ingeniørstandarder oversettes til felt-ytelse.
no.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Flerlags QC-system med strenge kontroller på hvert kritisk produksjonstrinn.
no.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Våre forskningsfasiliteter inkludert PVC-stofflaboratorium, hydrodynamisk testbasseng og prototypeverksted.
no.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: 12 000 m²-anlegg med RF-sveising, drop-stitch-produksjon og skreddersydde monteringslinjer.
no.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Fullservice designdesign for skreddersydde ODM-prosjekter, fra konsept til produksjon.

no.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
no.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Enkelt. Étt kammer å finne og lappe.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderat. Må identifisere hvilket kammer som lekker. Reparasjonsprosessen er den samme.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 hovedluftkammer (+ en liten ytre sikkerhetsræling på enkelte modeller).
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 uavhengige kamre, hvert med sin egen ventil og trykkintegritet.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Ingen. Totalt tap av oppdrift ved svikt.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lettere. Færre indre sveisesømmer og ventiler gir mindre materiale.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Noe tyngre. Indre skillevegger og ekstra ventilkomponenter tilfører vekt.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mer kompakt når det er tømt. Enklere å oppbevare og reise med.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Noe større. Indre skiller hindrer helt flat sammenfolding.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Raskere. Bare ett kammer å blåse opp.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Treigere. Hvert kammer må blåses opp separat.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: God. Et enkelt stort kammer holder jevnt trykk.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Utmerket. Indre skillevegger reduserer bøyning og gir en stivere plattform.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lavere. Enklere produksjon med færre komponenter.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Høyere. Kompleks indre konstruksjon og flere ventiler øker kostnaden.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderat. Enkelt svakpunkt hvis hovedkammeret blir kompromittert.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
no.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
no.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

el.commercialWorkboats.a2desc: Ικανότητα ταχείας απόκρισης με εξαιρετική ευελιξία σε περιορισμένα λιμάνια και παράκτια ύδατα.
el.commercialWorkboats.a3desc: Υλικά ανθεκτικά σε χημικά για έκθεση σε καύσιμα, λάδι και διαλύτες. Στιβαρή κατασκευή για συνεχείς επιχειρήσεις.
el.commercialWorkboats.a4desc: Αθόρυβες, σταθερές πλατφόρμες για υδρογραφικές έρευνες, περιβαλλοντική παρακολούθηση και επιστημονική έρευνα.
el.commercialWorkboats.a6desc: Πλατφόρμες ταχείας ανάπτυξης για υποστήριξη πυρόσβεσης και αντιμετώπιση εκτάκτων αναγκών σε ρηχά ύδατα.
el.commercialWorkboats.ctaSub: Υλικά υψηλής ποιότητας, προηγμένη τεχνολογία ραφών και στιβαρή κατασκευή μεταφράζονται σε λιγότερες επισκευές, λιγότερο χρόνο διακοπής και μεγαλύτερη επιχειρησιακή διάρκεια ζωής.
el.commercialWorkboats.f1desc: Το ιδιόκτητο πολυστρωματικό σύνθετο ύφασμά μας διαθέτει βάση πολυεστέρα ή νάιλον υψηλής πυκνότητας ενθυλακωμένη σε προηγμένες συμπολυμερείς επιστρώσεις.
el.commercialWorkboats.f2desc: Thermo-welding creates molecular bonds stronger than the fabric itself. For applications requiring adhesives, we use high-performance two-part polyurethane adhesives in climate-controlled environments. Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.
el.commercialWorkboats.f3desc: Εξαρτήματα από ανοξείδωτο χάλυβα 316, ενισχυμένες τρόπιδες, πολλαπλοί ανεξάρτητοι αεροθάλαμοι με εσωτερικά διαφράγματα για πλεονασμό ζημιάς.

el.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Πολυεπίπεδο σύστημα ΠΕ με αυστηρούς ελέγχους σε κάθε κρίσιμο βήμα κατασκευής.
el.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Οι ερευνητικές μας εγκαταστάσεις περιλαμβάνουν εργαστήριο υφασμάτων PVC, δεξαμενή υδροδυναμικών δοκιμών και εργαστήριο πρωτοτύπων.

el.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Πλήρως εξοπλισμένο στούντιο σχεδιασμού για προσαρμοσμένα έργα ODM, από τη σύλληψη έως την παραγωγή.
el.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Εξαιρετική σταθερότητα και ρηχό βύθισμα. Θήκες καλαμιών, βάσεις εξοπλισμού, ανυψωμένα καθίσματα και πιο ήσυχα χρώματα.
el.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Ελαφριές και συμπαγείς για εύκολη αποθήκευση. Αποδοτική κωπηλασία και πρόωση με ενισχυμένα σημεία ρυμούλκησης.
el.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Ευέλικτος σχεδιασμός για οικογενειακή βόλτα με υψηλή προτεραιότητα στη σταθερότητα, ασφάλεια, άνεση και ευκολία μεταφοράς.
