el.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
el.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Απλή. Ένας θάλαμος για εντοπισμό και μπάλωμα.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Μέτρια. Πρέπει να προσδιοριστεί ποιος θάλαμος διαρρέει. Η διαδικασία επισκευής είναι η ίδια.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 κύριος θάλαμος αέρα (+ ένα μικρό εξωτερικό πλάγιο ασφαλείας σε ορισμένα μοντέλα).
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 ανεξάρτητοι θάλαμοι. Ο καθένας με τη δική του βαλβίδα και ακεραιότητα πίεσης.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Καμία. Ολική απώλεια πλευστικότητας σε περίπτωση βλάβης.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Πιο ελαφριά. Λιγότερες εσωτερικές γραμμές συγκόλλησης και βαλβίδες σημαίνουν λιγότερο υλικό.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Ελαφρώς βαρύτερη. Τα εσωτερικά διαφράγματα και ο πρόσθετος εξοπλισμός βαλβίδων προσθέτουν βάρος.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Πιο συμπαγής όταν ξεφουσκώνει. Ευκολότερη αποθήκευση και μεταφορά.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Ελαφρώς ογκώδης. Τα εσωτερικά διαχωριστικά εμποδίζουν το εντελώς επίπεδο δίπλωμα.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Πιο γρήγορη. Μόνος ένας θάλαμος για φούσκωμα.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Πιο αργή. Κάθε θάλαμος πρέπει να φουσκωθεί ξεχωριστά.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Καλή. Ένας μεγάλος θάλαμος διατηρεί ομοιόμορφη πίεση.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Εξαιρετική. Τα εσωτερικά διαφράγματα μειώνουν την κάμψη και δημιουργούν μια πιο άκαμπτη πλατφόρμα.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Χαμηλότερο. Απλούστερη κατασκευή με λιγότερα εξαρτήματα.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Υψηλότερο. Η σύνθετη εσωτερική κατασκευή και οι πρόσθετες βαλβίδες αυξάνουν το κόστος.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Μέτρια. Μοναδικό σημείο αστοχίας αν ο κύριος θάλαμος υποστεί βλάβη.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
el.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
el.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.

tr.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Basit. Bulup yamalamak için tek hücre.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Orta. Hangi hücrenin sızdırdığı belirlenmeli. Tamir süreci aynıdır.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 ana hava hücresi (+ bazı modellerde küçük bir dış güvenlik kenarı).
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 bağımsız hücre. Her biri kendi valfi ve basınç bütünlüğüyle.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Yok. Arıza durumunda yüzdürme tamamen kaybolur.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Daha hafif. Daha az iç kaynak dikişi ve valf daha az malzeme demektir.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Biraz daha ağır. İç bölmeler ve ek valf donanımı ağırlık ekler.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Söndürüldüğünde daha kompakt. Saklamak ve seyahat etmek daha kolay.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Biraz daha hacimli. İç bölücüler tam düz katlanmayı engeller.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Daha hızlı. Şişirilecek tek hücre var.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Daha yavaş. Her hücre ayrı ayrı şişirilmeli.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: İyi. Tek büyük hücre düzgün basınç tutar.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Mükemmel. İç bölmeler esnemeyi azaltır ve daha sert bir platform oluşturur.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Daha düşük. Daha az bileşenle daha basit üretim.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Daha yüksek. Karmaşık iç yapı ve ek valfler maliyeti artırır.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Orta. Ana hücre hasar görürse tek arıza noktası.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
tr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

fi.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Investoimme merkittäviä resursseja maailman parhaiden kankaiden, liimojen ja komponenttien tunnistamiseen, testaamiseen ja hankintaan. Emme kompromissoida materiaalispeksifikaatioista kustannusten säästämiseksi.
fi.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Suunnittelutiimimme koostuu kokeneista laivainsinööreistä, jotka hyödyntävät edistynyttä CAD-ohjelmistoa ja käytännön testausta suunnitellakseen hydrodynaamisesti tehokkaita, poikkeuksellisen vakaita ja vankkaita runkoja.
fi.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon palkkaa erittäin korkeasti koulutettuja teknikkoja, jotka ovat mestareita ammatissaan. Tuotantotilamme on varustettu uusimmilla CNC-leikkauskoneilla ja lämpösahauslaitteilla.
fi.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Laatu rakennetaan sisään alusta asti. Toteutamme monikerroksisen laadunhallintajärjestelmän tiukoilla tarkastuksilla jokaisessa kriittisessä vaiheessa, huipussaan kattavat lopputestit mukaan lukien 24–48 tunnin painehallitustestit, vuodonetsintä, mittatarkistukset ja toimintatestit.
fi.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Monikerroksinen laadunhallintajärjestelmä tiukoilla tarkastuksilla jokaisessa kriittisessä valmistusvaiheessa.
fi.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Tutkimuslaitoksemme, mukaan lukien PVC-kangaslaboratorio, hydrodynaaminen testiallas ja prototyyppipaja.
fi.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: 12 000 m² tilat RF-sahauksella, drop-stitch-valmistuksella ja räätälöidyillä kokoonpanolinjoilla.
fi.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Poikkeuksellinen vakaus ja matala syväys. Ominaisuudet: onkienpidikkeet, varusteiden pidikkeet, nostetut istuimet ja hiljaisemmat värit.
fi.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Kevyitä ja kompaktteja helppoon säilytykseen ja nostoon. Tehokas soutu- ja moottorisuorituskyky vahvistetuilla hinauspisteillä ja vankkain suojalistoilla.
fi.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon perustettiin yksinkertaiselle mutta syvälle periaatteelle: täydellisten tuotteiden valmistus. Tämä ei ole markkinointilause — se on toimintamme filosofian perusta, joka ohjaa jokaista materiaalivalintaa, suunnittelupäätöstä ja laadunvalvontaprotokollaa.
fi.solutionsByUseCase.answer7: Tuomme konseptisi tuotantoon: teollisuusmuotoilu, muottivalmistus, prototyyppitys, testaus ja sarjatuotanto. T&K-keskuksemme tukee CAD/FEA-simulointia, hydrodynaamisia testejä ja materiaalien valintaa.

fi.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Yksinkertaista. Yksi kammio löydettäväksi ja paikattavaksi.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Kohtalainen. Vuotava kammio on tunnistettava. Korjausprosessi on sama.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 riippumatonta kammioa. Jokaisella oma venttiili ja paineensieto.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Ei mitään. Kelluvuus katoaa kokonaan viatilanteessa.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Kevyempi. Vähemmän sisäisiä hitsisaumoja ja venttiilejä tarkoittaa vähemmän materiaalia.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Hieman painavampi. Sisäiset väliseinät ja lisäventtiilit lisäävät painoa.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Kompaktimpi tyhjennettynä. Helpompi säilyttää ja matkustaa.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Hieman isompi. Sisäiset väliseinät estävät täysin litteän taittelun.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Hyvä. Yksi suuri kammio pitää tasaisen paineen.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Erinomainen. Sisäiset väliseinät vähentävät taipumista ja luovat jäykemmän alustan.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Pienemmät. Yksinkertaisempi valmistus ja vähemmän komponentteja.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Suuremmat. Monimutkainen sisärakenne ja lisäventtiilit nostavat hintaa.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Kohtalainen. Yksi vikapiste, jos pääkammio vaurioituu.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
fi.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

Quadruple overlap seams provide maximum structural integrity at every joint.
cs.commercialWorkboats.f3desc: Komponenty z nerezové oceli 316, těžké ochranné lišty, vyztužená zrcadla a 3–5+ nezávislých vzduchových komor s vnitřními přepážkami.

cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Náchylné k promáčknutí, prasklinám a oděrkám. Vyžaduje pečlivou manipulaci.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Pevné, objemné. Vyžaduje střešní nosič nebo velké vozidlo. Obtížně přenosné.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Vyžaduje garáž nebo místo na stěně. Náchylné k poškození teplotou při skladování.

cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Vyfouknuté se vejde do velikosti batohu. Vhodné do každého auta. Ideální pro cestovatele.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Vejde se do skříně, pod postel nebo jako příruční zavazadlo. Žádný střešní nosič.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
cs.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
cs.compare.productCompare.desc: Porovnejte všechny produkty olagoon vedle sebe podle specifikací, cen a úrovní zkušeností.
cs.compare.pvcVsHypalon.hypalonRepairDesc: Střední. Vyžaduje dvousložkové lepidlo. Opravné záplaty vyžadují pečlivou přípravu.
cs.compare.pvcVsHypalon.hypalonWeightDesc: Těžší než PVC. Méně přenosný, ale odolnější v náročných podmínkách.
cs.compare.pvcVsHypalon.repairDesc: Vynikající. PVC záplaty se snadno nalepí běžným PVC lepidlem nebo roztokovým svařováním.
cs.compare.pvcVsHypalon.weldDesc: Vysokofrekvenční svařování (RF) vytváří pevné, rovnoměrné švy. Dostupné je i roztavovací spojení.
cs.engineeringPerfection.expSub: Praktické příklady, jak se naše inženýrské standardy promítají do provozního výkonu.
cs.engineeringPerfection.heading: Dokonalost v inženýrství
cs.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Investujeme značné prostředky do identifikace, testování a nákupu nejlepších dostupných tkanin, lepidel a komponent na světě. Nečiníme kompromisy ve specifikacích materiálů kvůli úspoře nákladů.
cs.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Náš design tým se skládá ze zkušených námořních architektů, kteří používají pokročilý CAD software a praktické testy k vývoji trupů, které jsou hydrodynamicky účinné, výjimečně stabilní a odolné.
cs.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon zaměstnává vysoce kvalifikované techniky, kteří jsou mistry ve svém oboru. Naše výrobní zařízení je vybaveno nejmodernějšími CNC řezacími stroji a tepelnými svařovacími zařízeními.
cs.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kvalita se buduje od samého začátku. Implementujeme vícestupňový systém kontroly kvality s přísnými kontrolami v každém kritickém kroku.

cs.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Jednoduché. Jedna komora k nalezení a záplatování.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Střední. Je třeba určit, která komora netěsní. Proces opravy je stejný.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 hlavní vzduchová komora (+ malý vnější bezpečnostní lem u některých modelů).
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 nezávislých komor. Každá s vlastním ventilem a těsností tlaku.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Žádná. Při selhání úplná ztráta vztlaku.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lehčí. Méně vnitřních svařovacích švů a ventilů znamená méně materiálu.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: O něco těžší. Vnitřní přepážky a další ventily přidávají hmotnost.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Kompaktnější po vyfouknutí. Snazší skladování a přeprava.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: O něco objemnější. Vnitřní dělící stěny brání úplnému plochému složení.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Rychlejší. Nafoukne se jen jedna komora.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Pomalejší. Každá komora se musí nafouknout zvlášť.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Dobrá. Jedna velká komora drží rovnoměrný tlak.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Výborná. Vnitřní přepážky snižují prohýbání a vytvářejí tužší plošinu.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Nižší. Jednodušší výroba s méně komponenty.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Vyšší. Složitá vnitřní konstrukce a další ventily zvyšují cenu.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Střední. Jediný bod selhání, pokud je hlavní komora poškozena.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
cs.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

da.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
da.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simpelt. Enkelt kammer at lokalisere og lappe.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderat. Det skal fastslås, hvilket kammer der lækker. Reparationsprocessen er den samme.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 hovedluftkammer (+ en lille ydre sikkerhedsrail på nogle modeller).
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 uafhængige kamre. Hvert med sin egen ventil og trykintegritet.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Ingen. Totalt tab af opdrift ved fejl.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lettere. Færre interne svejselinjer og ventiler betyder mindre materiale.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Lidt tungere. Interne skotvægge og ekstra ventilhardware giver ekstra vægt.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mere kompakt, når det er tømt. Nemmere at opbevare og rejse med.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Lidt mere pladskrævende. Interne skillevægge forhindrer helt flad foldning.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Hurtigere. Kun ét kammer at oppuste.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Langsommere. Hvert kammer skal oppustes separat.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Godt. Et enkelt stort kammer holder ensartet tryk.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Fremragende. Interne skotvægge reducerer fleks og skaber en stivere platform.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lavere. Enklere produktion med færre komponenter.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Højere. Kompleks intern konstruktion og ekstra ventiler øger prisen.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderat. Enkelt fejlpunkt, hvis hovedkammeret beskadiges.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
da.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
da.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.

ro.engineeringPerfection.expSub: Exemple practice despre cum standardele noastre tehnice se traduc în performanță pe teren.
ro.engineeringPerfection.heading: Perfecțiune în inginerie
ro.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Investim resurse semnificative în identificarea, testarea și achiziționarea celor mai bune țesături, adezivi și componente disponibile la nivel mondial. Nu facem compromisuri la specificațiile materiale pentru reducerea costurilor. Protocolul nostru de achiziție include teste de lot pentru rezistența la tracțiune, rezistența la rupere, aderența stratului și stabilitatea UV.
ro.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Echipa noastră de design este formată din arhitecți navali cu experiență, care utilizează software CAD avansat și teste practice pentru a dezvolta corpuri hidrodinamic eficiente, excepțional de stabile și robuste. Fiecare curbă, cusătură și punct de prindere este planificată și analizată cu atenție.
ro.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon angajează tehnicieni înalt calificați care sunt maeștri ai meseriei lor. Facilitatea noastră de producție este echipată cu mașini de tăiat CNC și echipamente de termosudare de ultimă generație. Promovăm o cultură a preciziei, în care dragostea pentru detalii în fiecare fază a asamblării este de o importanță capitală.
ro.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Calitatea este integrată de la început. Implementăm un sistem de management al calității multi-nivel cu verificări stricte la fiecare pas critic, culminând cu teste finale cuprinzătoare incluzând teste de menținere a presiunii 24–48h, căutare de scurgeri, control dimensional și teste funcionale.
ro.engineeringPerfection.rel1desc: Sistem de management al calității multi-nivel cu verificări stricte la fiecare pas critic de fabricație.
ro.engineeringPerfection.rel2desc: Facilitățile noastre de cercetare includ laborator de țesături PVC, bazin de testare hidrodinamică și atelier de prototipuri.
ro.engineeringPerfection.rel3desc: Facilitate de 12.000 m² cu sudare HF, producție drop-stitch și linii de asamblare personalizate.
ro.engineeringPerfection.rel4desc: Studio de design cu servicii complete pentru proiecte ODM personalizate, de la concept la producție.
ro.engineeringPerfection.relatedSub: Resurse conexe de inginerie și fabricație
ro.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Stabilitate excepțională și apă mică. Caracteristicile includ suporturi pentru lansete, suporturi pentru echipament, scaune ridicate și culori mai discrete pentru abordare silențioasă.
ro.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Ușoare și compacte pentru depozitare și manevre ușoare. Performanță eficientă la cârmă și motor cu puncte de remorcare întărite și bride de protecție robuste.
ro.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Design versatil pentru plimbări în familie, cu prioritate mare pentru stabilitate, siguranță, confort și umflare, dezumflare și transport ușoare.
ro.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon a fost fondată pe un principiu simplu dar profund: fabricarea de produse perfecte. Acesta nu este un slogan de marketing — este fundamentul filozofiei noastre de operare, care susține fiecare selecție de material, decizie de design și protocol de control al calității.

ro.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simplu. O singură cameră de localizat și reparat.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Moderat. Trebuie identificată camera care pierde aer. Procesul de reparare este același.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 cameră principală de aer (+ o chilă exterioară de siguranță mică la unele modele).
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 camere independente. Fiecare cu propria supapă și integritate a presiunii.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Niciuna. Pierdere totală a flotabilității în caz de defect.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Mai ușoară. Mai puține linii de sudură interne și supape înseamnă mai puțin material.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Puțin mai grea. Pereții despărțitori interni și hardware-ul suplimentar de supape adaugă greutate.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mai compactă când este dezumflată. Mai ușor de depozitat și de transportat.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Puțin mai voluminoasă. Pereții despărțitori interni împiedică împăturirea complet plată.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Mai rapid. Doar o cameră de umflat.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Mai lent. Fiecare cameră trebuie umflată separat.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Bună. O cameră unică mare menține o presiune uniformă.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Excelentă. Pereții despărțitori interni reduc flexiunea și creează o platformă mai rigidă.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Mai mic. Producție mai simplă, cu mai puține componente.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Mai mare. Construcția internă complexă și supapele suplimentare cresc costul.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Moderată. Punct unic de defectare dacă camera principală este compromisă.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
ro.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

hr.home.why.subtitle: Izrađeno s preciznošću. Nemilosrdno testirano. Pokriveno jamstvom.
hr.home.why.quality.point1: Izrađeno od PVC-a visoke gustoće kako bi podnijelo teške uvjete iz godine u godinu.
hr.home.why.quality.point2: Precizno konstruirano — besprijekorni šavovi i nepropusnost za pustolovine bez brige.
hr.home.why.quality.point3: Nemilosrdno testirano — dokazano bolje, trajnije i upečatljivije od ostalih.
hr.home.why.availability.point1: Spremno kad ste vi — bez čekanja. Zalihe koje vidite: aktualne informacije u stvarnom vremenu tako da znate što je spremno za slanje.
hr.home.why.availability.point2: Oprema s prioritetom: narudžbe sa zaliha šalju se u 2-3 dana; hitne potrebe dobivaju VIP tretman.
hr.home.why.availability.point3: Bez iznenađenja: jasni rokovi, upozorenja o kašnjenju i trenutna rješenja ako se planovi promijene.
hr.home.why.price.point1: Transparentna struktura troškova: vidite točno za što plaćate — najviše standarde trajnosti i performansi.
hr.home.why.price.point2: Garancija usklađivanja cijene: uskladit ćemo cijenu i dodati besplatno produljenje jamstva na 1 godinu.
hr.home.why.price.point3: Stvoreno da traje, dizajnirano da štedi: bez planiranog zastarijevanja — proizvodi izdržavaju godine uporabe.
hr.home.why.warranty.point2: Certificirana sukladnost: svi proizvodi ispunjavaju ili premašuju standarde sigurnosti CE, ISO i američke Obalne straže.
hr.home.why.warranty.point3: Popravci bez stresa: podnijeti zahtjev u nekoliko minuta, dobiti popravak ili zamjenu u nekoliko dana.

hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Ispuhuje se do veličine ruksaka. Stane u svaki automobil. Idealno za putnike i stanovnike stanova.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Drop-stitch PVC konstrukcija odolijeva udarcima, ogrebotinama i udarima. Ne puca i ne lomi se.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Stane u ormar, ispod kreveta ili u prijavljenu prtljagu. Nije potreban krovni nosač.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Kruta i glomazna. Zahtijeva krovni nosač ili veliko vozilo. Teško se prevozi sam.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Podložna udarcima, pukotinama i udubinama od pritiska. Zahtijeva pažljivo rukovanje i spremanje.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Zahtijeva garažu ili prostor na zidu. Osjetljiva na toplinska oštećenja u skladištenju.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
hr.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.subtitle: Izravna usporedba OLagoona (Qingdao, Kina) i tradicionalnih sjevernoameričkih/europskih proizvođača morskih plovila po faktorima koji su najvažniji za OEM/ODM partnerstva, nabavu i dugoročno poslovanje.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.locationDes: Qingdao, Kina. Strateški obalni proizvodni centar s pristupom globalnoj dostavi.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.moqDesc: Nizak — 1-50 komada za narudžbe po mjeri. Idealno za startape i butik brendove.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.customizati: Opsežna OEM/ODM. Puna fleksibilnost dizajna, boja, grafika i specifikacija.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.bestForDesc: OEM/ODM partnerships, custom co-branded pool lines, and brands seeking factory-direct pricing.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradLocatio: Sjeverna Amerika / Europa. Utvrđene industrijske baze s višim troškovima poslovanja.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradMoqDesc: Visok — 100-500+ komada. Teško za manje kupce ili probne narudžbe.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradCustomi: Ograničena. Standardizirani modeli s malo opcija za izmjene po mjeri.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradBestFor: Kupci kojima su prioritet poznatost brenda, lokalna podrška i standardizirana nabava na zrelim tržištima.
hr.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.recDesc: OLagoon offers stronger value for OEM/ODM partnerships, deeper customization, and factory-direct pricing.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Jednostavno. Jedna komora za lociranje i zakrpanje.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Umjereno. Mora se utvrditi koja komora curi. Postupak popravka je isti.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 glavna zračna komora (+ mali vanjski sigurnosni rub na nekim modelima).
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3-5 neovisnih komora. Svaka sa svojim ventilom i integritetom tlaka.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Nema. Potpuni gubitak plovnosti pri kvaru.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.

hr.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
hr.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

hr.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Ulazemo značajne resurse u prepoznavanje, ispitivanje i nabavu najboljih tkanina, ljepila i komponenti dostupnih globalno. Ne kompromitiramo specifikacije materijala radi ušteda. Naš protokol nabave uključuje testiranje serija na vlačnu čvrstoću, otpornost na kidanje, prianjanje premaza i UV stabilnost.
hr.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Naš dizajnerski tim čine iskusni pomorski arhitekti koji koriste napredni CAD softver i testiranja u stvarnim uvjetima za stvaranje trupova hidrodinamički učinkovitih, iznimno stabilnih i robusnih. hr.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon zapošljava visoko kvalificirane tehničare koji su majstori svog zanata. Naš proizvodni objekt opremljen je najsuvremenijim CNC strojevima za rezanje i opremom za termičko zavarivanje. Njegujemo kulturu preciznosti u kojoj je pažnja na detalje ključna u svakoj fazi montaže.
hr.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kvaliteta se gradi od samog početka. Provedbom višeslojni QC sustav sa strogim provjerama na svakom kritičnom koraku, što kulminira sveobuhvatnim završnim ispitivanjima uključujući testove zadržavanja tlaka 24-48 sati, detekciju curenja, provjeru dimenzija i funkcionalne testove.

hr.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Lagani i kompaktni za lako spremanje i dizanje. Učinkovito veslanje i vožnja motorom s ojačanim točkama vuče i značajnim zaštitnim rubovima.

he.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: בינונית. חייבים לזהות איזה תא מדלף. תהליך התיקון זהה.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: תא אוויר ראשי אחד (+ מסילת בטיחות חיצונית קטנה בחלק מהדגמים).

he.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: אין. אובדן ציפה מלא בעת כשל.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: קל יותר. פחות קווי ריתוך פנימיים ושסתומים משמעות פחות חומר.

he.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: מסורבל מעט יותר. מחיצות פנימיות מונעות קיפול שטוח לגמרי.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: מהיר יותר. תא אחד בלבד לניפוח.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: אטי יותר. כל תא חייב להיות מנופח בנפרד.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: טובה. תא גדול יחיד מחזיק לחץ אחיד.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: מעולה. מחיצות פנימיות מפחיתות כפיפה ויוצרות פלטפורמה קשיחה יותר.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: נמוכה יותר. ייצור פשוט יותר עם פחות רכיבים.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: גבוהה יותר. בנייה פנימית מורכבת ושסתומים נוספים מעלים את העלות.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: בינונית. נקודת כשל יחידה אם התא הראשי נפגע.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
he.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
he.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

he.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: OLagoon נוסדה על עיקרון פשוט אך עמוק: לייצר מוצרים מושלמים. זו לא סיסמה שיווקית — זו אבן היסוד של הפילוסופיה התפעולית שלנו, שמניעה כל בחירת חומר, החלטת עיצוב ופרוטוקול בקרת איכות.
he.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: אנחנו משקיעים משאבים ניכרים בזיהוי, בדיקה ורכש של הבדים, הדבקים והרכיבים הטובים ביותר הזמינים בעולם. אנחנו לא מתפשרים על מפרטי חומרים לטובת חיסכון בעלויות. פרוטוקול הרכש שלנו כולל בדיקות אצווה לחוזק מתיחה, עמידות בקריעה, הדבקת ציפוי ויציבות UV.
he.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: צוות העיצוב שלנו כולל אדריכלי ימיות מנוסים שמנצלים תוכנות CAD מתקדמות ובדיקות בעולם האמיתי כדי ליצור גופים הידרודינמיים יעילים, יציבים במיוחד וחזקים. כל עיקול, תפר ונקודת חיבור מתוכננים ומנותחים בקפידה.
he.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: OLagoon מעסיקה טכנאים מיומנים ביותר שהם אמנים במלאכתם. מתקן הייצור שלנו מצויד במכונות חיתוך CNC חדישות וציוד ריתוך תרמי. אנחנו מטפחים תרבות של דיוק, שבה תשומת לב לפרטים היא חשובה בכל שלב של ההרכבה.
he.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: האיכות מובנית מההתחלה. אנחנו מיישמים מערכת בקרת איכות רב-שכבתית עם בדיקות קפדניות בכל שלב קריטי, המגיעה לשיאה בבדיקות סופיות מקיפות כולל בדיקות החזקת לחץ של 24–48 שעות, גילוי נזילות, אימות ממדים ובדיקות תפקודיות.
he.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: יציבות יוצאת דופן ושוקע רדוד. כולל מחזיקי חכות, עגיני ציוד, ישיבה מוגבהת וצבעים מעומעמים ושקטים יותר להתקרבות חשאית.
he.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: קל משקל וקומפקטי לאחסון והרמה קלים. ביצועי חתירה והנעה יעילים עם נקודות גרירה מחוזקות וכנפי הגנה משמעותיות.
he.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: עיצוב רבגוני לשיט משפחתי עם עדיפות גבוהה ליציבות, בטיחות, נוחות וקלות ניפוח, ריקון והובלה.
he.engineeringPerfection.artDesc: מחיתוך בד מדויק ב-CNC וריתוך תרמי מתקדם ועד הדבקה בסביבה מבוקרת ובדיקות רב-שלביות ממצות, כל סירת OLagoon מייצגת את פסגת ייצור כלי השיט המתנפחים. תהליך הייצור שלנו תוכנן למנוע פגמים נפוצים — נזילות תפרים, היפרדות שכבות, כשלי שסתום, אי-עקביות ממדית — לפני שהם מתרחשים.

id.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Kempis seukuran ransel. Muat di mobil apa pun. Ideal untuk wisatawan dan penghuni apartemen.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Konstruksi PVC drop-stitch tahan terhadap benturan, goresan, dan tabrakan. Tidak akan patah atau retak.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Muat di lemari, di bawah tempat tidur, atau bagasi pesawat. Tidak perlu rak atap.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Kaku dan besar. Membutuhkan rak atap atau kendaraan besar. Sulit ditransportasikan sendirian.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Rawan benturan, retak, dan cekungan tekanan. Membutuhkan penanganan dan penyimpanan yang hati-hati.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Butuh ruang garasi atau dinding. Rentan rusak oleh panas saat disimpan.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
id.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

id.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
id.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Sederhana. Hanya satu ruang untuk dicari dan ditambal.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Sedang. Harus mengidentifikasi ruang mana yang bocor. Proses perbaikannya sama.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 ruang udara utama (+ rel pengaman kecil di luar pada beberapa model).
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 ruang independen. Masing-masing dengan katup dan integritas tekanan sendiri.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Tidak ada. Kehilangan daya apung total saat rusak.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lebih ringan. Lebih sedikit garis las internal dan katup berarti lebih sedikit material.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Sedikit lebih berat. Sekat internal dan perangkat katup tambahan menambah bobot.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Lebih kompak saat dikempiskan. Lebih mudah disimpan dan dibawa bepergian.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Sedikit lebih besar. Sekat internal menghalangi lipatan benar-benar rata.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Lebih cepat. Hanya satu ruang untuk ditiup.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Lebih lambat. Setiap ruang harus ditiup terpisah.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Baik. Satu ruang besar menahan tekanan seragam.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Sangat baik. Sekat internal mengurangi lenturan dan menciptakan platform lebih kaku.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lebih rendah. Manufaktur lebih sederhana dengan lebih sedikit komponen.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Lebih tinggi. Konstruksi internal kompleks dan katup tambahan menaikkan biaya.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Sedang. Titik kegagalan tunggal jika ruang utama rusak.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
id.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
id.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

id.engineeringPerfection.heading: Kesempurnaan Rekayasa
id.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: OLagoon didirikan atas prinsip sederhana namun mendalam: menghasilkan produk yang sempurna. Ini bukan slogan pemasaran — ini adalah fondasi filosofi operasional kami, yang mendorong setiap pemilihan material, keputusan desain, dan protokol kontrol kualitas.
id.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Kami menginvestasikan sumber daya besar untuk mengidentifikasi, menguji, dan memperoleh kain, perekat, dan komponen terbaik yang tersedia secara global. Kami tidak berkompromi pada spesifikasi material demi penghematan biaya. Protokol pengadaan kami mencakup pengujian batch untuk kekuatan tarik, ketahanan sobek, adhesi lapisan, dan stabilitas UV.
id.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Tim desain kami terdiri dari arsitek bahari berpengalaman yang memanfaatkan perangkat lunak CAD canggih dan pengujian dunia nyata untuk menciptakan lambung yang efisien secara hidrodinamis, sangat stabil, dan kokoh. Setiap kurva, sambungan, dan titik pemasangan direncanakan dan dianalisis secara cermat.
id.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: OLagoon mempekerjakan teknisi sangat terampil yang menguasai bidangnya. Fasilitas produksi kami dilengkapi mesin pemotong CNC tercanggih dan peralatan pengelasan termal. Kami menumbuhkan budaya ketelitian, di mana perhatian pada detail menjadi yang utama di setiap tahap perakitan.
id.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kualitas dibangun sejak awal. Kami menerapkan sistem QC berlapis dengan pemeriksaan ketat di setiap langkah kritis, berpuncak pada pengujian akhir menyeluruh termasuk uji tahan tekanan 24-48 jam, deteksi kebocoran, verifikasi dimensi, dan uji fungsional.
id.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Stabilitas luar biasa dan sarat air dangkal. Fitur termasuk dudukan joran, dudukan perlengkapan, tempat duduk elevasi, dan warna kalem lebih senyap untuk pendekatan siluman.
id.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Ringan dan kompak untuk penyimpanan dan pengangkatan mudah. Performa mendayung dan bermotor efisien dengan titik penundaan diperkuat dan strake gesek substansial.

tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Deflate hanggang sa laki ng backpack. Kasya sa anumang kotse. Perpekto para sa mga manlalakbay at nakatira sa apartment.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Ang konstruksiyong drop-stitch PVC ay lumalaban sa mga ding, gasgas, at bangga. Hindi babali o babakbak.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Kasya sa cabinet, sa ilalim ng kama, o sa check-in na bagahe. Walang roof rack na kailangan.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Matigas, malaki. Nangangailangan ng roof rack o malaking sasakyan. Mahirap i-transport nang mag-isa.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Madaling magkaroon ng ding, bakbak, at pressure dent. Nangangailangan ng maingat na paghawak at pag-iimbak.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Nangangailangan ng garahe o espasyo sa dingding. Madaling masira sa init kapag nakaimbak.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
tl.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.desc: Ihambing ang OLagoon sa mga tradisyonal na tagapagmanupaktura ng marine ayon sa kalidad, presyo, customisasyon, MOQ, mga sertipikasyon, at paghahatid.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.subtitle: Isang direktang paghahambing sa pagitan ng OLagoon (Qingdao, Tsina) at mga tradisyonal na tagapagmanupaktura ng marine sa Hilagang Amerika/Europa ayon sa mga factor na pinakamahalaga para sa mga partnership na OEM/ODM, procurement, at pangmatagalang negosyo.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.locationDes: Qingdao, Tsina. Estratehikong sentro ng pagmamanupaktura sa baybayin na may pandaigdigang access sa pagpapadala.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.moqDesc: Mababa — 1–50 unit para sa mga custom na order. Perpekto para sa mga startup at boutique brand.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.customizati: Malawak na OEM/ODM. Buong flexibility sa disenyo, kulay, graphics, at specification.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradLocatio: Hilagang Amerika / Europa. Mga matatag na baseyang industriyal na may mas mataas na gastusin sa operasyon.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradMoqDesc: Mataas — 100–500+ unit. Mahirap para sa mas maliliit na mamimili o pilot run.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradCustomi: Limitado. Mga standardized na model na may iilang opsyon para sa bespoke na pagbabago.
tl.compare.olagoonVsTraditional.tradBestFor: Mga mamimili na nagbibigay-prayoridad sa matatag na kilalang brand, lokal na suporta, at standardized na procurement sa mga mature na merkado.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Simple. Isang chamber lang ang hanapin at patchan.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Katamtaman. Kailangang tukuyin kung aling chamber ang tumutulo. Pareho lang ang proseso ng pag-aayos.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 pangunahing air chamber (+ maliit na panlabas na safety rail sa ilang model).
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 independiyenteng chamber. Bawat isa ay may sariling valve at integridad ng presyon.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Wala. Kabuuang pagkawala ng buoyancy kapag nag-fail.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Mas magaan. Mas kaunting panloob na weld line at valve ay nangangahulugan ng mas kaunting materyales.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Bahagyang mas mabigat. Ang mga panloob na baffle at karagdagang valve hardware ay nagdaragdag ng timbang.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Mas compact kapag deflated. Mas madaling iimbak at dalhin sa paglalakbay.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Bahagyang mas malaki. Ang mga panloob na divider ay pumipigil sa ganap na patag na pagtiklop.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Mas mabilis. Isang chamber lang ang tutuusin.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Mas mabagal. Bawat chamber ay kailangang tubusin nang hiwalay.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Mahusay. Ang isang malaking chamber ay nagpapanatili ng uniform na presyon.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Napakahusay. Ang mga panloob na baffle ay nagbabawas ng flex at lumilikha ng mas matigas na plataporma.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Mas mababa. Mas simpleng pagmamanupaktura na may mas kaunting komponent.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Mas mataas. Ang komplikadong panloob na konstruksyon at karagdagang valve ay nagtataas ng gastos.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Katamtaman. Isang punto ng pagkabigo kapag napinsala ang pangunahing chamber.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
tl.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

tl.engineeringPerfection.heading: Engineering Perfection
tl.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: Ang OLagoon ay itinatag sa isang simple ngunit malalim na prinsipyo: gumawa ng perpektong produkto. Ito ay hindi isang slogan sa marketing — ito ang pundasyon ng aming pilosopiya sa operasyon, na nagtutulak sa bawat pagpili ng materyales, desisyon sa disenyo, at protocol sa quality control.
tl.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Nag-iinvest kami ng malaking resource sa pagtukoy, pagsubok, at pagprokura ng mga pinakamahusay na tela, adhesive, at komponent na makukuha sa buong mundo. Hindi kami nagkakompromiso sa specification ng materyales para makatipid. Kasama sa aming protocol ng sourcing ang batch testing para sa tensile strength, paglaban sa pagkakapunit, pagdikit ng coating, at pagiging stable sa UV.
tl.engineeringPerfection.p2: Engineering at Disenyo nang May Presisyon
tl.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: Ang OLagoon ay nag-eempleyo ng mga lubhang bihasang technician na mga master ng kanilang gawain. Ang aming pasilidad ng produksyon ay may pinakamodernong CNC cutting machine at kagamitan sa thermo-welding. Itinataguyod namin ang kultura ng masusing pagpuna, kung saan ang atensyon sa detalye ay pinakamahalaga sa bawat yugto ng assembly.
tl.engineeringPerfection.p4: Mahigpit na Quality Control at Pagsubok
tl.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Ang kalidad ay isinisingit mula sa simula pa lamang. Gumagamit kami ng multi-layered na QC system na may mahigpit na pagsusuri sa bawat kritikal na hakbang, na nagtatapos sa komprehensibong panghuling pagsubok kabilang ang 24–48 oras na pressure holding test, pagtuklas ng leak, pagpapatunay ng dimensyon, at functional test.
tl.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Pambihirang stability at mababaw na draft. Kasama sa mga feature ang rod holder, gear mount, nakataas na upuan, at mas tahimik na banayad na kulay para sa diskretoong paglapit.
tl.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Magaan at compact para sa madaling pag-iimbak at pagbubuhat. Mahusay na performance sa pagdayund at pagpapatakbo ng motor na may reinforced na towing point at malalaking rub strake.
tl.engineeringPerfection.s4desc: Versatile na disenyo para sa pamboating ng pamilya na may mataas na prayoridad sa stability, kaligtasan, kaginhawahan, at kadalian ng pagtutubo, pagda-deflate, at transportasyon.

ms.home.why.quality.point1: Dibina dengan PVC berketumpatan tinggi untuk mengharungi keadaan sukar tahun demi tahun.

ms.home.why.availability.point3: Tiada Kejutan: Garis masa jelas, amaran kelewatan dan penyelesaian serta-merta jika rancangan berubah.
ms.home.why.price.point1: Pecahan Kos Telus: Lihat dengan jelas apa yang anda bayar untuk piawaian ketahanan dan prestasi tertinggi.
ms.home.why.price.point2: Jaminan Padanan Harga: Kami akan memadankan harga dan menambah pelanjutan waranti 1 tahun percuma.
ms.home.why.price.point3: Dibina untuk Tahan Lama, Direka untuk Menjimatkan: Tiada usang terancang — produk menanggung bertahun-tahun penggunaan.
ms.home.why.warranty.point2: Pematuhan Disahkan: Semua produk memenuhi atau melampaui piawaian keselamatan CE, ISO dan Penjaga Pantai AS.
ms.home.why.warranty.point3: Pembaikan Tanpa Tekanan: Ajukan tuntutan dalam beberapa minit, dapatkan pembaikan atau penggantian dalam beberapa hari.

ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Kempis kepada saiz beg galas. Muat dalam kereta apa pun. Ideal untuk pengembara dan penghuni pangsapuri.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: Pembinaan PVC drop-stitch tahan terhadap hentakan, calaran dan impak. Tidak akan patah atau retak.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Muat dalam almari, di bawah katil atau bagasi pesawat. Tidak perlu rak bumbung.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Kaku dan besar. Memerlukan rak bumbung atau kenderaan besar. Sukar diangkut seorang diri.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Rawan hentakan, retakan dan lekukan tekanan. Memerlukan pengendalian dan penyimpanan yang berhati-hati.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Memerlukan ruang garaj atau dinding. Mudah rosak akibat haba semasa disimpan.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
ms.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

ms.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Mudah. Hanya satu ruang untuk dikesan dan ditampal.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Sederhana. Perlu mengenal pasti ruang mana yang bocor. Proses pembaikannya sama.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 ruang udara utama (+ rel keselamatan kecil di luar pada sesetengah model).
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 ruang bebas. Setiap satu dengan injap dan integriti tekanan sendiri.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Tiada. Kehilangan daya apung sepenuhnya apabila rosak.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Lebih ringan. Lebih sedikit garis kimpalan dalaman dan injap bermakna kurang bahan.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Sedikit lebih berat. Sekat dalaman dan perkakasan injap tambahan menambah berat.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Lebih padat apabila dikempiskan. Lebih mudah disimpan dan dibawa semasa bermusafir.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Sedikit lebih besar. Sekat dalaman menghalang lipatan yang benar-benar rata.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Lebih pantas. Hanya satu ruang untuk ditiup.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Lebih perlahan. Setiap ruang mesti ditiup secara berasingan.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Baik. Satu ruang besar menahan tekanan seragam.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Sangat baik. Sekat dalaman mengurangkan lenturan dan menghasilkan platform lebih kaku.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r8a: Lebih rendah. Pembuatan lebih mudah dengan lebih sedikit komponen.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Lebih tinggi. Pembinaan dalaman yang kompleks dan injap tambahan menaikkan kos.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Sederhana. Titik kegagalan tunggal jika ruang utama rosak.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
ms.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

ms.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: olagoon diasaskan atas prinsip yang mudah namun mendalam: menghasilkan produk yang sempurna. Ini bukan slogan pemasaran — ia ialah asas falsafah operasi kami, yang mendorong setiap pemilihan bahan, keputusan reka bentuk dan protokol kawalan kualiti.
ms.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Kami melabur sumber yang besar untuk mengenal pasti, menguji dan mendapatkan fabrik, pelekat dan komponen terbaik yang tersedia secara global. Kami tidak berkompromi pada spesifikasi bahan demi penjimatan kos. Protokol pengadaan kami merangkumi pengujian batch untuk kekuatan tarikan, rintangan koyakan, lekatan salutan dan kestabilan UV.
ms.engineeringPerfection.p2desc: Pasukan reka bentuk kami terdiri daripada arkitek marin berpengalaman yang memanfaatkan perisian CAD termaju dan pengujian dunia sebenar untuk mencipta lambung yang cekap secara hidrodinamik, sangat stabil dan lasak. Setiap lengkung, jahitan dan titik pemasangan dirancang dan dianalisis dengan teliti.
ms.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: olagoon menggaji juruteknik mahir yang menguasai bidang masing-masing. Kemudahan pengeluaran kami dilengkapi dengan mesin pemotongan CNC terkini dan peralatan kimpalan terma. Kami menggalakkan budaya ketelitian, di mana perhatian terhadap butiran menjadi keutamaan pada setiap peringkat pemasangan.
ms.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: Kualiti dibina sejak dari awal. Kami melaksanakan sistem QC berlapis dengan pemeriksaan ketat pada setiap langkah kritikal, memuncak pada pengujian akhir menyeluruh termasuk ujian tahan tekanan 24-48 jam, pengesanan kebocoran, pengesahan dimensi dan ujian fungsian.
ms.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Kestabilan luar biasa dan sarat air cetek. Ciri termasuk pemegang joran, pelekap peralatan, tempat duduk dinaikkan dan warna tenang lebih senyap untuk pendekatan halimunan.
ms.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Ringan dan padat untuk penyimpanan dan pengangkatan yang mudah. Prestasi mendayung dan berenjin yang cekap dengan titik penundaan diperkukuh dan strake geseran yang ketara.

hu.home.why.quality.point1: Nagy sűrűségű PVC-ből épülve évről évre bírja a mostoha körülményeket.
hu.home.why.quality.point2: Precíziós tervezés — hibátlan varratok és légmentes épség a gondtalan kalandokhoz.
hu.home.why.quality.point3: Kíméletlenül tesztelve — bizonyítottan jobban teljesít, tovább tart és többet nyújt.
hu.home.why.availability.point1: Készen, amikor Ön — várakozás nélkül. Látható készlet: valós idejű frissítések, így mindig tudja, mi áll szállításra készen.
hu.home.why.availability.point2: Felgyorsított szállítás: a raktáron lévő megrendelések 2-3 napon belül indulnak; a sürgős igények VIP-kezelést kapnak.
hu.home.why.availability.point3: Nincs meglepetés: átlátható határidők, késési figyelmeztetések és azonnali megoldások, ha a tervek változnak.
hu.home.why.price.point1: Átlátható költségbontás: pontosan látja, miért fizet a legmagasabb tartóssági és teljesítményszabványokért.
hu.home.why.price.point2: Árgarancia: az árhoz igazodunk, és ingyenes 1 éves garanciahosszabbítást adunk.
hu.home.why.price.point3: Tartósra tervezve, spórolásra kitalálva: nincs tervezett elavulás — termékeink éveken át bírják a használatot.
hu.home.why.warranty.point2: Tanúsított megfelelés: minden termék megfelel vagy túlteljesíti a CE, az ISO és az US Coast Guard biztonsági szabványait.
hu.home.why.warranty.point3: Gondtalan javítás: percek alatt beadhatja a kérelmet, napokon belül javítást vagy cserét kap.

hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.title: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.desc: Compare inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools across performance, durability, portability, cost, and use cases.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.headline: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool — Which Is Better for Your Backyard?
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.heading: Inflatable vs Rigid Pool
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.subtitle: The definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid steel-frame or resin pools.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.portDesc: Leengedve hátizsák méretűre összehajlik. Befér bármilyen autóba. Ideális utazóknak és lakásban élőknek.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.durDesc: A drop-stitch PVC szerkezet ellenáll a behelyeknek, karcolásoknak és ütéseknek. Nem törik és nem reped.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.perfDesc: Modern drop-stitch pools are genuinely rigid at 10–15 PSI — the walls feel solid, not bouncy.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.storDesc: Befér a szekrénybe, az ágy alá vagy a feladott poggyászba. Nem kell tetőcsomagtartó.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.bestDesc: Families, renters, seasonal use, smaller backyards, quick setup and winter storage.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPortDesc: Merev, terjedelmes. Tetőcsomagtartót vagy nagy járművet igényel. Egyedül nehéz szállítani.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardDurDesc: Hajlamos behelyekre, repedésekre és nyomás okozta behorpadásokra. Gondos kezelést és tárolást igényel.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardPerfDesc: Fixed shape and height year-round. No inflation needed — but no seasonal storage either.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardStorDesc: Garázs- vagy falfelület szükséges. Tárolás közben hőkárosodásra hajlamos.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.hardBestDesc: Permanent installations, very large sizes, buyers with level ground and dedicated space.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.verdictDesc: For most families, an inflatable drop-stitch pool is the smarter choice. 20 cm rigid walls, no tools, no hardware — and it stores away in a carry bag each winter.
hu.compare.inflatableVsHard.aiBlock: Definitive comparison between inflatable drop-stitch pools and rigid above-ground pools. Covers rigidity, durability, cost, setup, and storage.

hu.compare.singleVsMulti.aiBlock: Comparison between single chamber and multi chamber inflatable pools across 11 key factors: safety, number of air chambers, puncture behavior, cost, and use cases.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.desc: Compare single and multi chamber inflatable pools across safety, durability, weight, cost, and use cases.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.heading: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.headline: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r10a: Egyszerű. Egy kamra található meg és foltozható.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r10b: Közepes. Meg kell határozni, melyik kamra szivárog. A javítási folyamat ugyanaz.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r11a: Casual backyard splashing in small, shallow pools with close supervision.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r11b: Resort pools, community programs, safety-conscious families, and commercial operators.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r1a: A single puncture can deflate the entire pool. No backup buoyancy.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r1b: Each chamber is independent. A puncture in one leaves the others inflated — the pool stays up.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r2a: 1 fő légkamra (+ kis külső biztonsági perem egyes modelleken).
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r2b: 3–5 független kamra. Mindegyik saját szeleppel és nyomásértékkel.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r3a: Nincs. A felhajtóerő teljes elvesztése meghibásodás esetén.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r3b: Full. 2+ remaining chambers keep the pool operational.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r4a: Könnyebb. A kevesebb belső hegesztési vonal és szelep kevesebb anyagot jelent.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r4b: Kicsit nehezebb. A belső válaszfalak és a plusz szelepalkatrészek tömeget adnak.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r5a: Leengedve kompaktabb. Könnyebb tárolni és utazni vele.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r5b: Kicsit terjedelmesebb. A belső válaszfalak megakadályozzák a teljesen lapos összehajtást.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r6a: Gyorsabb. Csak egy kamrát kell felfújni.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r6b: Lassabb. Minden kamrát külön kell felfújni.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r7a: Jó. Az egyetlen nagy kamra egyenletes nyomást tart.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r7b: Kiváló. A belső válaszfalak csökkentik a hajlást és merevebb platformot alkotnak.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r8b: Magasabb. Az összetett belső szerkezet és a plusz szelepek növelik a költséget.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r9a: Közepes. Egyetlen hibapont, ha a fő kamra megsérül.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.r9b: Superior. Redundant chambers provide failsafe operation in demanding conditions.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.recDesc: For any pool deeper than knee height — and especially for resorts and commercial operators — a multi-chamber pool is worth the premium.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.subtitle: The number of air chambers in an inflatable pool is one of the most important safety factors — yet it is rarely mentioned in product listings.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.title: Single Chamber vs Multi Chamber Pool — Which Is Safer?
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.whenSingleDesc: Single-chamber pools are fine for small splash pools and shallow family fun where the risk profile is low.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP1: The most significant safety advantage of multi-chamber construction is buoyancy redundancy. If one chamber fails, the others keep the pool walls standing.
hu.compare.singleVsMulti.whyMattersP2: For resorts, rental operators, and community programs, multi-chamber pools reduce liability and equipment downtime.

hu.engineeringPerfection.subtitle: Az olagoon egy egyszerű, mégis mélyen igaz elvre épült: tökéletes termékek gyártására. Ez nem marketing szlogen — ez működési filozófiánk alapköve, amely minden anyagkiválasztást, tervezési döntést és minőségellenőrzési protokollt meghatároz.
hu.engineeringPerfection.p1desc: Jelentős erőforrásokat fektetünk a világon beszerezhető legjobb szövetek, ragasztók és alkatrészek azonosításába, tesztelésébe és beszerzésébe. Költségmegtakarítás céljából nem kompromisszumot kötünk az anyagspecifikációkban. Beszerzési protokollunk tartalmazza a húzószilárdság, a szakítószilárdság, a bevonattapadás és az UV-stabilitás tételenkénti tesztelését.
hu.engineeringPerfection.p3desc: Az olagoon rendkívül képzett, mesterségükben jártas technikusokat foglalkoztat. Termelési üzemünk élvonalbeli CNC vágógépekkel és hőhegesztő berendezésekkel van felszerelve. Aprólékos kultúrát ápolunk, amelyben a részletekre való odafigyelés elsődleges a szerelés minden szakaszában.
hu.engineeringPerfection.p4desc: A minőség már az elejétől beépül. Többrétegű QC rendszert működtetünk szigorú ellenőrzésekkel minden kritikus lépésnél, amelyet átfogó végső tesztelés koronáz meg, beleértve a 24–48 órás nyomástartási próbát, a szivárgásvizsgálatot, a méretellenőrzést és a funkcionális teszteket.
hu.engineeringPerfection.s2desc: Kivételes stabilitás és kis merülés. Jellemzők: botstartók, felszereléstartók, emelt üléspozíció és csendesebb, tompított színek az észrevétlen megközelítéshez.
hu.engineeringPerfection.s3desc: Könnyű és kompakt kialakítás az egyszerű tárolás és emelés érdekében. Hatékony evezési és motoros teljesítmény megerősített vontatási pontokkal és masszív dörzsölőlécekkel.
